verdict.summary: Marvell has become a concentrated AI data-infrastructure growth vehicle, with exceptional demand and a valuation that assumes flawless custom-silicon execution. Fiscal Q2 2027 revenue reached a record $2.739 billion, up 37% year over year; data-center revenue accelerated 46%. GAAP gross margin was 53.1% and GAAP diluted EPS $0.33, versus 58.9% and $0.94 on a non-GAAP basis. Q3 guidance of $3.15 billion plus or minus 5% and $1.10 plus or minus $0.05 non-GAAP EPS confirms acceleration. The AI transmission spans custom accelerators, PAM DSPs, Ethernet and optical connectivity, so Marvell can earn content both inside and around the XPU. The counterweight is 73.4x EV/EBITDA and 22.8x EV/revenue, customer concentration, $5.28 billion debt and Series A preferred dilution. The April 424B5 is senior-note debt, not a warrant. Wait: MRVL's $228.88 level is not observable as an active setup in the captured bars. A new post-event RTH base must define the next trigger before any quantity or order exists.

business.overview:
Marvell designs data-infrastructure semiconductors for data centers, enterprise networking, carriers, consumer and automotive/industrial markets. Its portfolio includes custom compute silicon, Ethernet switching, optical/PAM connectivity, storage controllers and PHYs.

The AI channel is broad: custom accelerators monetize hyperscaler silicon programs, while DSPs, switches and electro-optics move data between accelerators and racks. Q2 data-center revenue growth of 46% shows that connectivity and custom silicon are already reported revenue, not only a roadmap claim.

The model breaks if a large customer's custom program slips, customers internalize more design work, or foundry/substrate capacity constrains ramps. Data-center concentration, preferred-stock dilution and a 22.8x revenue multiple magnify program-level errors. Custom AI ASIC revenue arrives through long design cycles and customer-specific ramps, while electro-optics and storage remain cyclical. The model breaks if a hyperscaler slips a tape-out, insources silicon, or gross margin fails to recover as custom programs scale faster than higher-margin infrastructure products.
business.moat: Marvell's moat is the combination of custom ASIC design capability and a portfolio of high-speed connectivity IP that can be reused around each customer program. Long co-development cycles and leading-edge SerDes expertise create switching friction, but customer ownership of roadmaps and dependence on external manufacturing cap pricing power and control.

capitalStructure.shareHistory: Marvell's Q1 FY2027 filing reconciles 882.0M basic weighted-average common-equivalent shares, including 7.9M preferred equivalents, to 893.3M diluted after 11.3M awards and warrants; another 3.0M potential shares were anti-dilutive. The legal issuance layer is separate: Celestial acquisition 8-K/A 0001193125-26-032861 records 24,601,976 common shares plus about 3.0M assumed options, while XConn resale filings evidence at least 2,263,077 acquisition shares already issued. The Celestial and XConn 424B7 resale blocks are subsets of those acquisition shares and are not added again. Contingent claims are shown separately: NVIDIA's $2.0B Series A preferred is initially convertible into up to 21,778,000 common shares, and Google's August warrant covers up to 58,970,907 shares at $206.58, with 1,360,867 time-vesting and the balance purchase-vesting through FY2033. The Q2 release uses 921M diluted shares for Q3 non-GAAP EPS guidance. Because the 876.9M vendor count, acquisition closing dates, preferred conversion, Google vesting and options overlap in timing, no synthetic current fully diluted total is asserted.

filings.finding: The FY2026 Form 10-K supplies Marvell's data-center/customer concentration, external-manufacturing, custom-silicon and debt risk baseline needed to judge whether current AI growth can produce durable common-equity returns.
The August 27 earnings Form 8-K and direct Exhibit 99.1 support $2.739B Q2 revenue, 53.1% GAAP gross margin and Q3 revenue guidance of $3.15B plus or minus 5%.
The April 6 Form 424B5 is the preliminary document for the senior-note chain finalized two days later; it is not counted as a separate financing.

The final April 8 Form 424B2 prices $1.0B of 5.300% senior notes due 2036 at $998.85M, with about $989.2M net proceeds intended principally to repay the 1.650% 2026 notes. This is issuer debt, not common dilution.

The February 6 Form 424B7 registers resale of up to 24,222,758 Celestial AI acquisition shares. Marvell receives no proceeds; the shares are acquisition consideration already issued, not a new primary sale.
The February 18 Form 424B7 registers resale of up to 2,116,573 XConn acquisition shares with no issuer proceeds; it is included once in the observable acquisition-share scenario.

The March 19 Form 424B7 covers a later 300,874-share Celestial AI holder-resale tranche with no issuer proceeds. It is distinct from the February 24,222,758-share block, enters the observable acquisition-share scenario once and does not represent a new primary offering by Marvell.

The July 9 Form 424B7 covers a later 146,504-share XConn holder-resale tranche with no issuer proceeds. It is distinct from the February 2,116,573-share XConn block, enters the observable acquisition-share scenario once and does not represent new issuer financing.

The August 19 Form 8-K records issuance to Google of a warrant for up to 58,970,907 Marvell common shares at $206.58. Of that amount, 1,360,867 shares vest over one year and the balance vests against custom-product purchases through fiscal 2033. It is a contingent customer warrant, not current legal shares or an ATM.

The March 31 Form 8-K records NVIDIA's $2.0B Series A preferred investment, initially convertible into up to 21,778,000 Marvell common shares. The preferred is an equity-linked contingent claim and is separated from basic legal shares, quarterly diluted EPS and holder-resale filings.

The February 2 Form 8-K/A records 24,601,976 common shares issued for Celestial AI, approximately 3.0M assumed options and possible additional earnout shares. Later Celestial 424B7 resale blocks are subsets of this acquisition consideration and are not counted as new primary issuance.

The Q1 FY2027 Form 10-Q reconciles 882.0M basic weighted-average common-equivalent shares, including 7.9M preferred equivalents under two-class accounting, to 893.3M diluted shares after 11.3M awards and warrants; another 3.0M potential shares were anti-dilutive.

Advanced wafers, substrates and outsourced test are limited-source dependencies during rapid ramps.
